title: mentha spicata var. cordifolia
intro: Mentha spicata var. cordifolia, commonly known as Heartleaf Peppermint, is a variant of the peppermint plant with heart-shaped leaves. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include relief from digestive issues such as indigestion and nausea, as well as its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory problems like coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Mentha spicata var. cordifolia include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to ease cramps, reduce swelling, and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthol, menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
